_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Acquiring Credentials#000.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 取得 Gavel 护照

Acquiring Credentials#001.src: I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
Acquiring Credentials#001.dst: 很抱歉，先生，我不能就这样给你一本新护照……你需要先取得——的批准……
Acquiring Credentials#001.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#002.src: But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
Acquiring Credentials#002.dst: 可是先生，我的护照被偷了！我 {~} 分钟内就要搭飞艇去 {p}。我真的急需一本……
Acquiring Credentials#002.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#003.src: I've already told you where where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#003.dst: 我已经告诉过你要去哪里办新护照了。下一位，谢谢！
Acquiring Credentials#003.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#004.src: Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#004.dst: 嗯……{u}，是吧？很遗憾，人类必须在 Wynn 办理护照。
Acquiring Credentials#004.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#005.src: I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#005.dst: 恐怕我帮不了你。下一位，谢谢！
Acquiring Credentials#005.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#006.src: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
Acquiring Credentials#006.dst: 嘿，你！对，就是你！能到外面来一下吗？我想我们可以互相帮忙。
Acquiring Credentials#006.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#007.src: So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
Acquiring Credentials#007.dst: 那个，我听到你跟官员的对话了……你也在找护照，对吧？
Acquiring Credentials#007.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#008.src: Well... so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
Acquiring Credentials#008.dst: 嗯……是这样，我听说航空站里藏着一个秘密黑市。
Acquiring Credentials#008.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#009.src: Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
Acquiring Credentials#009.dst: 听说他们在交易违禁品……一定有办法买到护照，我敢肯定！
Acquiring Credentials#009.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#010.src: If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
Acquiring Credentials#010.dst: 如果我们合作，也许能找到进去的办法。你觉得怎么样？
Acquiring Credentials#010.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#011.src: Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#011.dst: 在航空站四处探索，寻找关于黑市的线索。

Acquiring Credentials#012.src: Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
Acquiring Credentials#012.dst: 噢，你带我们来旅店了！嗯……酒保在这里工作很久了……
Acquiring Credentials#012.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#013.src: Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know... all, uh... sneaky-like.
Acquiring Credentials#013.dst: 也许他知道黑市的事！我去问问看，你懂的……很，呃……不动声色地问。
Acquiring Credentials#013.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#014.src: Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
Acquiring Credentials#014.dst: 打扰一下，先生……你，呃……该不会刚好知道这附近有什么特别便宜的店吧？
Acquiring Credentials#014.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#015.src: The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
Acquiring Credentials#015.dst: 盛宴的餐桌已经摆好，要黑啤还是啤酒，你选哪个？
Acquiring Credentials#015.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#016.src: Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Acquiring Credentials#016.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#017.src: Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
Acquiring Credentials#017.dst: 成功了吗？他会让我们进去吗？
Acquiring Credentials#017.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#018.src: I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#018.dst: 我想要找到进去的办法也没那么容易……你觉得这条线索能带我们去哪，{u}？
Acquiring Credentials#018.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#019.src: Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#019.dst: 我们继续探索吧。你带路。
Acquiring Credentials#019.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#020.src: Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#020.dst: 继续在航空站探索，寻找关于黑市的线索。

Acquiring Credentials#022.src: Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
Acquiring Credentials#022.dst: 嘿，呃……你也觉得这些人看起来很可疑吗？
Acquiring Credentials#022.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#023.src: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#023.dst: 飞艇指挥官们爱着他们所恨之物。
Acquiring Credentials#023.speaker: Waiter

Acquiring Credentials#024.src: I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
Acquiring Credentials#024.dst: 我觉得我们有眉目了！继续走吧。
Acquiring Credentials#024.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#025.src: Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#025.dst: 跟着线索走：飞艇指挥官们爱着他们所恨之物。

Acquiring Credentials#026.src: Hmmm... these crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
Acquiring Credentials#026.dst: 嗯……这些箱子里装满了物品。也许我们可以拿一些给指挥官？
Acquiring Credentials#026.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#027.src: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#027.dst: 一旦撕裂，便永远无法修复。
Acquiring Credentials#027.speaker: Commander

Acquiring Credentials#028.src: Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
Acquiring Credentials#028.dst: 噢，我们继续走吧！这条线索能带我们去哪？
Acquiring Credentials#028.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#029.src: Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#029.dst: 跟着线索走：一旦撕裂，便永远无法修复。

Acquiring Credentials#030.src: Who's that on top of that platform?!
Acquiring Credentials#030.dst: 那个站在平台上面的是谁？！
Acquiring Credentials#030.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#031.src: The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
Acquiring Credentials#031.dst: 你们两个为了这个走了好远，是吧？
Acquiring Credentials#031.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#032.src: Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market with just that.
Acquiring Credentials#032.dst: 嗯，黑啤和啤酒那个问题的答案我可以告诉你们！不过光靠这个是进不了黑市的。
Acquiring Credentials#032.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#033.src: You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
Acquiring Credentials#033.dst: 你们看，要进黑市，你们得有东西卖！而且可不是能在这附近随便买到的东西，懂我意思吧。
Acquiring Credentials#033.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#035.src: Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
Acquiring Credentials#035.dst: 没错！算你们走运，我今天心情好。附近停着一艘飞艇。我们可以把它开走，我能帮你们弄到一件货。
Acquiring Credentials#035.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#036.src: Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well... you could get something out of this too, right?
Acquiring Credentials#036.dst: 呃……你觉得呢，{u}？我真的很需要那本护照，而且……你也能从中捞到点好处，对吧？
Acquiring Credentials#036.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#038.src: Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Acquiring Credentials#038.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#040.src: Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
Acquiring Credentials#040.dst: 等等！有守卫在看守飞艇。别让他们看到你！
Acquiring Credentials#040.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#041.src: They're near the edge... Push them off.
Acquiring Credentials#041.dst: 他们站在边缘附近……把他们推下去。
Acquiring Credentials#041.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#042.src: Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
Acquiring Credentials#042.dst: 呃……我相信他们没事的，我相信那一下摔得不算太高……
Acquiring Credentials#042.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#043.src: Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
Acquiring Credentials#043.dst: 好了，这是唯一进去的路！前面还有更多守卫。不被发现地解决他们，我们就安全了！
Acquiring Credentials#043.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#044.src: Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Acquiring Credentials#044.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#045.src: Did you just... Push them all...?
Acquiring Credentials#045.dst: 你刚才是……把他们全推下去了……？
Acquiring Credentials#045.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#046.src: Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
Acquiring Credentials#046.dst: 系好安全带！我们要去 {p}，在那里可以收集一些幼龙蛋，让你们拿去黑市卖！
Acquiring Credentials#046.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#047.src: Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
Acquiring Credentials#047.dst: 与机械师和 Doan 一起前往 {p} 取得幼龙蛋。

Acquiring Credentials#048.src: The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
Acquiring Credentials#048.dst: 我们要去的岛上有个幼龙巢！那里很难抵达，所以它们会在那里产卵。
Acquiring Credentials#048.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#049.src: And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
Acquiring Credentials#049.dst: 那些蛋在黑市能卖很多钱，对吧……？
Acquiring Credentials#049.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#050.src: They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#050.dst: 那当然！幼龙蛋很稀有，而且这座岛只有搭飞艇才去得了……在 Letvus 可是值一大笔钱。
Acquiring Credentials#050.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#051.src: Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
Acquiring Credentials#051.dst: 噢，就在那里！我从这里就看得到那座岛了，系好安全带。我们要去偷蛋了！
Acquiring Credentials#051.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#052.src: What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
Acquiring Credentials#052.dst: 那是什么？！噢……看来有人跟我们抢了……
Acquiring Credentials#052.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#053.src: Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
Acquiring Credentials#053.dst: 可恶，空袭者来了！不能让他们带着那些蛋跑掉……
Acquiring Credentials#053.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#054.src: Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
Acquiring Credentials#054.dst: 好吧，既然这样，那就只有一件事能做了！快，跟我来！
Acquiring Credentials#054.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#055.src: We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
Acquiring Credentials#055.dst: 路上有这么多海盗，我们到不了巢穴，杀了他们！
Acquiring Credentials#055.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#056.src: Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
Acquiring Credentials#056.dst: 好，跟我来！去把那颗蛋弄到手！
Acquiring Credentials#056.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#057.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
Acquiring Credentials#057.dst: 我取蛋的时候保护好我，人类！
Acquiring Credentials#057.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#058.src: We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
Acquiring Credentials#058.dst: 已经完成一半了，继续保护我！
Acquiring Credentials#058.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#059.src: There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Acquiring Credentials#059.dst: 搞定了！回飞艇上去，快跑！
Acquiring Credentials#059.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#060.src: Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Acquiring Credentials#060.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#061.src: Human, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
Acquiring Credentials#061.dst: 人类，别让他们打中我们！在炮弹打中飞艇之前，用你的武器攻击它们把它们弹开！
Acquiring Credentials#061.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#062.src: We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
Acquiring Credentials#062.dst: 我们挨不住更多炮击了……别浪费时间了，走吧！我们还有更大的鱼要抓！
Acquiring Credentials#062.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#063.src: That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
Acquiring Credentials#063.dst: 好险……那么，我们回航空站吧！
Acquiring Credentials#063.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#064.src: Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
Acquiring Credentials#064.dst: 与 Doan 一起回到黑鸟旅店的酒吧。

Acquiring Credentials#065.src: The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
Acquiring Credentials#065.dst: 你们两个今天确实证明了自己！
Acquiring Credentials#065.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#066.src: So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#066.dst: 所以，我会告诉你们进入黑市的暗号。
Acquiring Credentials#066.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#067.src: Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#067.dst: 回旅店找酒保，跟他说：我不渴，我总是随身带着一瓶。
Acquiring Credentials#067.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#068.src: That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
Acquiring Credentials#068.dst: 这样你们也许就有机会进去了。祝你们好运！
Acquiring Credentials#068.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#069.src: Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
Acquiring Credentials#069.dst: 谢谢你的帮忙，先生……那我们回酒吧吧。
Acquiring Credentials#069.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#070.src: Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
Acquiring Credentials#070.dst: 我们又回来了。去跟酒保说话吧。
Acquiring Credentials#070.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#071.src: Um, sir? I'm not thristy, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#071.dst: 呃，先生？我不渴，我总是随身带着一瓶。
Acquiring Credentials#071.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#072.src: Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
Acquiring Credentials#072.dst: 只跟走廊尽头的黑市成员说话，别跟其他任何人交谈。
Acquiring Credentials#072.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#074.src: Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
Acquiring Credentials#074.dst: 进入黑市，与走廊尽头的成员交谈。

Acquiring Credentials#075.src: I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
Acquiring Credentials#075.dst: 听说你们从空袭者那里偷了一些蛋。真是大胆！
Acquiring Credentials#075.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#077.src: Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
Acquiring Credentials#077.dst: 两本护照？我看大概要 {~} 绿宝石。在市场上卖掉这颗蛋就能凑到。
Acquiring Credentials#077.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#078.src: Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
Acquiring Credentials#078.dst: 让我跟你们说说这个市场怎么运作。你们的蛋一开始价格会很低，然后你们得到处找商人要求出更高的价。
Acquiring Credentials#078.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#079.src: Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
Acquiring Credentials#079.dst: 不过要小心，你们只能要求加价 {~} 次。
Acquiring Credentials#079.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#080.src: You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
Acquiring Credentials#080.dst: 你们可以试着跟不同的商人谈，看看每个人会把蛋的价格加多少。
Acquiring Credentials#080.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#081.src: Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
Acquiring Credentials#081.dst: 祝你们好运，尽量别被杀了。
Acquiring Credentials#081.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#082.src: Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
Acquiring Credentials#082.dst: 与商人们交谈，想办法凑到 {~} 绿宝石买护照。

Acquiring Credentials#083.src: That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
Acquiring Credentials#083.dst: 这就是我们需要的数目，{u}。成交！蛋归你了。
Acquiring Credentials#083.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#084.src: Here, you can have your emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#084.speaker: Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#086.src: Talk to the Black Market Member again.

Acquiring Credentials#087.src: So do you have the emeralds?
Acquiring Credentials#087.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#088.src: Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
Acquiring Credentials#088.dst: 嗯……这样就行了。来，你们的护照。
Acquiring Credentials#088.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#089.src: Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
Acquiring Credentials#089.dst: 呃……{u}，我想你的护照掉了。我帮你捡——
Acquiring Credentials#089.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#090.src: Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
Acquiring Credentials#090.dst: 等等……这是我的护照？！它一直都在我口袋里……
Acquiring Credentials#090.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#091.src: Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
Acquiring Credentials#091.dst: 那个，呃……那这些绿宝石就分你一些吧……
Acquiring Credentials#091.speaker: Doan
